 Too many groups to keep tabs on? Fear not, this is your one-stop guide to all the information you need to know about every upcoming comeback.
 Photo: HLL/Contributor/ImaZinS/Getty Images By  Nicole Ng and Natalie Hoe  -  published 6 Nov 2026 
 There’s only one thing we look forward to more than an upcoming concert and it’s, well... an upcoming comeback.
 In the 2000s, household names in the K-pop music industry like BIGBANG , Girls Generation and 2NE1 kickstarted the Hallyu wave. But it’s arguably only in the past seven years or so that K-pop has seeped into the global mainstream—notably thanks to artists like BTS , BLACKPINK , Stray Kids , and SEVENTEEN , to name a few. Now, the question is no longer “Who are they?” but “Who doesn’t know them?” 
 Korean acts have been lighting up stages on an international level, topping global charts and sparking a phenomenon. This comeback season, mark your calendars because a plethora of groups—both rookies and veterans—are coming back, and they’re not waiting for anyone. Get ready to stan all over again.

 Confirmed Returns
 6 November 2026: P1Harmony - BLOW UP
 P1Harmony is gearing up to refresh P1ece’s playlists with their tenth mini-album, BLOW UP . Embracing a cool hero concept, this release builds upon the storylines established in their previous albums UNIQUE and DUH! . Marking their highly anticipated return after eight months, our expectations are high for the performances they’ll be bringing to the stage. 
 9 November 2026: NCT Dream - DREAM AFTER DREAM
 NCTzens, the wait is finally over because our Dreamies are finally back after a long year of waiting. On 20 October 2026, the boy group released the music video for “The Sun”, a b-side of their upcoming album Dream After Dream. With a title track called “Boogie Woogie”, we’re ready to be hitting the dance floor with some moves.
 9 November 2026: Chaeryeong - Lovesick
 If you’re still experiencing PCD (post-concert depression) from ITZY’s concert in October, Chaeryeong is here to rescue you from it. Third in the group to go solo, the idol is making her solo debut with Lovesick this month. The album will feature four tracks, which we’re excited to add to our playlists.
 10 November 2026: ZEROBASEONE EMP - OFF script 
 ZEROBASEONE EMP , a sub-unit of ZEROBASEONE featuring Seok Matthew and Park Gunwook , is back with a digital single this November. Teaming up with iconic hip-hop duo Dynamic Duo —known for their hit track “AEAO”—for their title track “Run”, we can’t wait to see what the boys have been cooking up.
 10 November 2026: LNGSHOT - S.W.I.S.H.
 Fresh off of Jay Park’s Serenades & Body Rolls Latin America tour, LNGSHOT is already moonwalkin’ back with their brand new EP, S.W.I.S.H . On 21 October, the boys released their pre-release track “Masterpiece”, surprising SHOTTIES with a groovy tune and earning them praise for their musicality. We can’t wait to go bananas for the rest of the EP on 10 November.

 13 November 2026: ATEEZ - GOLDEN HOUR : Part 6
 The pirate kings are gearing up for even more adrenaline pumping bangers. After tearing the stage with their pre-release track “Drip”, ATINYs are absolutely pumped for the release of their fifteenth mini album. In other news, ATEEZ is also preparing for their 2027 World Tour: Zero To All kicking off in Incheon, South Korea on 22 January 2027—and you can be sure that these songs will be on their setlist.
 16 November 2026: TOMORROW X TOGETHER - PERFECT STORM
 Ahead of their fifth world tour, Steal The Wind, TOMORROW X TOGETHER is set to release their ninth mini-album, PERFECT STORM . Featuring six brand-new tracks, MOAs can expect another deep dive into their Star Seekers lore through their discography. 
 20 November 2026: NAYEON - NA-sty
 NAYEON is finally making her long-awaited return with her upcoming solo single, NA-sty. While not many details have been shared regarding the release, following the massive success of infectious anthems like “ABCD” and “POP!”, her latest single promises to deliver another irresistible, fun hit.
 20 November 2026: Yves - Cute & Anxiety
 EHNGDUs look out, because Yves is dropping her fifth EP Cute & Anxiety this November! On 27 October, the star released two tracks, “Hysteric” and “Adam”, which serve as pre-releases for the new EP. “Hysteric” follows a dark, alluring house groove while “Adam” has more of an experimental, space kind of feel. Yves is also set to perform at the Esplanade Annexe Studio in Singapore on 4 November 2026. 
 20 November 2026: ENHYPEN - THE SIN : PARALLEL WORLD 
 Our six vampires are booked and busy with their third comeback this year, THE SIN : PARALLEL WORLD. This spinoff single features three tracks, bringing the group’s THE SIN series to a close. The title track “I Want You” shares the story of fate and connection between two individuals. ENHYPEN will also be performing in Singapore and part of their Blood Saga World Tour at the National Stadium on 14 March 2027.
